question: What coverage baseline and failure policy should OpenClaw enforce before `pnpm test:coverage` is promoted as a trusted CI gate?
rationale: The current source explicitly treats coverage reporting as informational, while selecting a repository-wide failing baseline and rollout policy is a quality-policy decision rather than a mechanical workflow repair.

options.title: Define and enforce a baseline
options.body: Choose explicit coverage thresholds in the canonical Vitest configuration, retain the trusted main/manual rollout, and require a successful trusted-run artifact before merge.

options.title: Keep coverage informational
options.body: Rename or narrow this work to an advisory coverage-report lane rather than representing it as a threshold gate.

options.title: Pause pending CI policy ownership
options.body: Leave the PR open without merge action until a CI/quality owner confirms the desired threshold and enforcement rollout.

recommendation.title: Define and enforce a baseline
recommendation.body: Choose explicit coverage thresholds in the canonical Vitest configuration, retain the trusted main/manual rollout, and require a successful trusted-run artifact before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence establishes a CI quality-policy boundary but not a dependable individual owner.
